method:rack::app::RackWidget::setNextCab.finding: P0: set_next_cable_color_id accepts any int (native/bindings/app/rack.cpp:488), but Rack's getNextCableColor checks only id >= size before reading settings::cableColors[id] (Rack src/app/RackWidget.cpp:1624-1632).
